tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs and popovers sitting on surface. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, sidebar, code and zebra rows. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and row rules. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, buttons and checkboxes. 3:1 or better on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and the tints.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and column headers on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links, active states and focus. Text on surface, surface-raised and brand-tint; fill with on-brand text. Cocoa brown; it is never a status colour.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, positive badges and quiet highlights. Brand and ink read on it.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand or brand-hover fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold highlight: active navigation pill, the marked key word in a headline, delta chips, chart marks. Fill only, always with on-accent text; never text on surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Full-bleed brand panels: the login left half and the marketing call-to-action band. on-panel and on-panel-muted read on it.

tokens.name: on-panel
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on panel.

tokens.name: on-panel-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on panel.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, overdue amounts, destructive actions. Text on surface, surface-raised and danger-tint. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Error banners and Overdue badges. Danger reads on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs-attention text: Draft, Due soon, missing receipt. Reads on surface, surface-raised and warning-tint. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning banners and badges. Warning reads on it.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and in-progress states (Importing, Syncing). A teal, kept apart from the brand colour. Reads on surface, surface-raised and info-tint.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Info banners and badges. Info reads on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. 3:1 or better on every surface token in both themes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, buttons, badges, column headers.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Amounts in tables, account numbers, IBANs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tight badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and table-cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards and form sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, table chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and filter chips.

shadow.note: Borders separate surfaces first; shadows only lift overlays.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Raised cards that need a hint of lift.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs.
